lines: Oh, hello, {player}! You must be the new farmer. I'm Mira, I run the flower stall.
Let me show you around! The shop is over there, the shipping box is where you sell what you grow, and your bed is in the farmhouse.
Here, take these seeds. Use the shovel to till a patch of soil, plant a seed, and water it with the can. Go on, try it!
Shovel first, then a seed, then the watering can, {player}. One tile is enough to start!
Back again, {player}? The lilies are doing well this year.
Before your first harvest you should say hello to everyone, {player}. It's a small village, you'll meet them all in no time!
Maya, Ariane, Tom, Jonas at the shop... and the old folks, and Cyrus too, if you can find him. Go on!
Oh! H-hello. I'm Tom. I do carpentry, well, I'm learning it. From my grandpa.
Sorry, I'm not good at this. Welcome to the village!
Hi again. Um. If you ever need something built, I could... I mean, I'd like to try.
Welcome to my shop, {player}! I arrived only a few days before you, so we are both new here.
Take your time. Everything on the shelf is imported, and priced accordingly.
Tea? I always have a cup. Honey Lemon Tea, the way they make it back home.
Take your time, {player}.
Ah, {player}, there you are! I wanted to talk to you about tea.
Honey Lemon Tea is my favourite, but the honey they import here has no flavour at all. Artificial, I think.
But I have seen the flowers growing all over this valley. Real honey could be made here! Take this hive, I made it from spare boards.
Put it on grass, with plenty of flowers within five tiles. The bees will do the rest. It takes about three days.
Found a spot for the hive yet, {player}? Somewhere with plenty of flowers nearby.
You will thank me later. Real honey is nothing like the town sweets.
Good spot! Now give the bees a few days.
They know their business better than we do.
Hm. I do not see many flowers around your hive.
Bees need blossoms to make honey. Maybe you should plant it near some flowers instead.
Take it back with your pickaxe and move it next to the lilies and azaleas. They will be much happier.
Is that the honey? Let me see... Hm. Much darker than what we make back home.
And the taste is sharper, heavier. Unusual.
But it is good! Good in its own way. Keep some for yourself.
Honey every few days. I should have brought bees to this valley sooner.
So you have greeted the whole village, {player}! Everyone here talks about you already.
Here, a little welcome gift from the shop. Carrot seeds. They grow fast, you will like them.
Oh, a new face. Welcome to the village, {player}.
I don't talk much. If you want to know about plants, ask.
Hm. Back again.
Hey! New farmer! I'm Maya, I'm the blacksmith. The forge is that way. Wait, did I leave it on?
Anyway! Welcome!
Come for dinner some time! I'm working on a new recipe. An experimental one.
Hi! Who are you? Why are you here? What's that you're carrying?
I'm Clover! I draw everything. I'll draw you next!
Why do plants need water? What's under the ground? Can I see?
Oh... hello. You must be the new farmer. I'm Cyrus. I write novels, mostly. Or I try to.
It's fine. Everything's fine. Please don't mind me.
Oh, hello again. It's fine, I was just thinking. It's fine.
You're the new one, we spoke the other day. I can help you with something.
Harvest a crop and put it in the shipping box by your farm. It pays you for whatever you put in. Sell enough and you'll have some gold to grow on.
I'm not really good at making money myself, being a novelist and all. But I can still help a neighbour.
Hmph. A new farmer.
Don't go up the ridge. Ever.
Hmph.
Oh, hello, dear! You must be the new farmer. I'm Martha, Mira's granny.
Come see us sometimes. You look like you could use a hot meal.
Have you eaten, dear?
